investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Emberstack Press (news and media publishing); Platform: AWS eu-central-1 (zones eu-central-1a/eu-central-1b/eu-central-1c); network range 10.202.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster embers-prod-eucent (EKS); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for web-frontend; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
